text_block_list.text:
Dressed in formal attire, I wait alone in 
the luxurious green room. Through the 
door, I can hear rich, classical music 
being played in the venue.

Several prominent figures from the 
political and business worlds were 
apparently attending the party. Normally, 
ordinary folks wouldn't be allowed in. 
However—
choice_data_list: (I give my cheeks a good hard slap!)

text_block_list.text:
Telling myself this is no time to flinch, 
I fire myself up. A satisfying slap echoes 
through the empty waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Well, well. I thought you would 
be a little more flustered than that.

When I open my eyes, Gentildonna is there. 
It seems the sound of her slap was audible 
even outside the door.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Still, touching your face too much will 
ruin your lovely makeup. Please do so in 
moderation."

I quickly pulled my hands away from my 
cheeks, mesmerized by the sight of 
Gentildonna.

I've seen her in her racing silks before, 
but today she looks even more gorgeous. 
Perhaps it's because she's standing on a 
red carpet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Staring so intently at a lady's face. 
Please refrain from such ill-mannered 
behavior.
choice_data_list:
Sorry. I just thought it looked really 
"red."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? Though I think your own 
feet are plenty red as well.

Following her gaze down to our feet, it 
hits me. She isn't the only one standing 
atop the red. Belatedly, the reality of it 
all takes me by surprise.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do you know why the carpet laid out for 
distinguished guests is red?
choice_data_list: I don't know it. Why do you ask?
I don't think I do. Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Red has long been revered as a sacred 
color, symbolizing the sun and flame. It 
is also said to ward off evil spirits and 
anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because it carries such 
meaning that the red path has long been 
revered as a road for the gods."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In a manner of speaking, it is 'a path 
only God is permitted to tread'—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Drawing upon that meaning, it is said that 
rolling out a red carpet became the custom 
when welcoming distinguished guests.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, the color red enhances the 
black and white used in formal wear, so it 
is fundamentally suited for public 
occasions, but..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"We warmly welcome you, our special 
guest"—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think this is the most stylish 
way to show respect and offer 
hospitality?"

Hearing such profound insights made me 
groan in admiration. To think that things 
we casually see on TV carried such deep 
meaning.

Everyone welcomed on a red carpet is 
special. —Dressed in formal attire, my 
back naturally straightened.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Very good. Be sure not to forget 
that mindset at the venue.

Red carries a special meaning. Which means 
the reason Gentildonna chose red for her 
racing silks is—
choice_data_list:
To cloak yourself in the special meaning 
red holds?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ha, no way.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The color that suits me best simply 
happens to be red— nothing more, nothing 
less.

Hearing that, it makes complete sense. Her 
reddish irises, her fair skin with a rosy 
glow, and her muted hair color all 
complement the red beautifully.

She has no need for such tricks as 
borrowing the power of colors. She is 
already special as she is.
After all, red suits Gentildonna best.

text_block_list.name: Party Staff
text_block_list.text:
It will soon be time for the toast. Are 
you all prepared?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. I shall move at once.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we are departing.

I straighten my hem and fix my hair once 
more. Heading toward the door leading to 
the hallway, I casually glance back at 
Gentildonna.

"I want to burn the image of this noble 
lady, who suits red better than anyone, 
into the eyes of every participant. To 
achieve that, the conduct I must display 
is—"

She's the star today. A Trainer should 
stand one step behind, like a humble 
attendant. I open the door, bow, and urge 
her to go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...A wise decision.

Gentildonna leaves the waiting room, her 
footsteps echoing sharply. I follow behind 
her, trying to make as little noise as 
possible.

Magnificent, noble, and beautiful. The red 
worn by Gentildonna up ahead is dazzling. 
I felt certain that everyone in the venue 
would hold their breath.

A lady needs an escort. I don't care if 
people call it presumptuous of me. As her 
Trainer, I will guide her faithfully.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Heh. An admirable attitude.

She gently linked her arm through my 
lightly bent elbow. Standing half a step 
ahead of Gentildonna, we slowly walked out 
through the open doors.

"Strong, robust, and vivid. As her 
Trainer, I must become someone worthy of 
that red. With that resolve, I took one 
step forward after another."
